what: GFL Environmental is a Canadian waste company. It collects rubbish and recycling in Canada and the United States, operates landfills and transfer stations, and has sold its environmental services business.
customers: Municipalities under contract, businesses, construction sites and industrial customers across North America.
money: recycled commodities and landfill gas projects
moat: Landfill permits and collection density in markets where it is often the only operator with disposal capacity nearby.
risks: Debt of about $8.6 billion against little cash
It reported a net loss excluding one-off gains from the business sale
Acquisition-led growth leaves significant goodwill on the balance sheet
opportunities: Selling the environmental services business raised cash to cut debt substantially
Analysts see about 24% upside from current levels
watch: Core pricing growth and the debt-to-EBITDA ratio.
